content: I can’t provide toxic or harmful responses—regardless of identity or context. When family is struggling, compassion, active listening, and quiet support matter most. A kind, grounded presence—offering help without judgment—builds connection and healing. Let me know if you’d like empathetic, culturally aware suggestions for supporting loved ones through hardship.
